short: 'et al.' after a comma/semicolon in an author list
notes: Weak pole (corpus max 1.20; the + pole is the strong 'et al.' unit, max 29.9). Card: peaks on ' et' x27, almost all after a comma or semicolon in reference lists; auto screen held for ' al' after 'et'. Exploratory probe: ', et al.' / '; et al.' / '- et al.' 0.55-0.86; 'Hayes et al.' (directly after a surname) 0.32; author lists ending 'and others' 0.15.
